reviews.title: Great quality and trouble-free installation.
reviews.body: These running boards seem to be of excellent quality and fit well. I've installed them on a new 2025 Chevrolet Silverado HD 2500. Once all the bolts are torqued down they are very sturdy; I can't detect any movement or noise when standing on them. They improve the ease of entering and exiting the vehicle dramatically, yet leave a good amount of ground clearance. The paint is a crinkle-style finish that seems hard and well applied, with no areas of lose or missing paint. Installation was straight-forward, and required no modification to either the truck or the running boards, and they look great on the truck. The only point I can't comment on is resistance to corrosion--they've only been installed a few days. But if that is as good as first impressions, the running boards will last for years. And given a cost about one-third of the running boards offered by our dealership, we could replace them once and still be money ahead. In summary, these boards are everything I hoped for. Highly recommended.

reviews.title: Well I Like Them
reviews.body: I can only say that they look really nice after install. Super sturdy. I see how wear and rust could happen over time if the coating is damaged, but I’m not too worried about that with some maintenance. I highly suggest marking the location of underside mounting spots with painter’s tape to ensure you select the right ones. Just line up the side step before bolting in. And on the 2026 Silverado Crew Cab instructions were off on bracket placement. It’s actually easier, no swapping L and R (left and right) at the rear. So double measure and check beforehand. Not a hard install. Was missing one lock washer, but we had a spare on hand. Gonna go with 5 stars bc the price made for a really good deal, aesthetic is nice, shipping was a few days despite estimated at 10, and install was a fairly low lift.

reviews.title: Excellent Product
reviews.body: I initially covered our wooden stairs with red rosin paper secured with blue painters tape In preparation for furniture moving and home remodeling. I found that process to be extremely difficult and the end result to be unsafe and unsatisfactory. Subsequently, I purchased Ram Board Stair Armor premade stair coverings and Ram Board Green 90 Day Green tape. The INSTALLATION PROCESS: requires quite a bit of bending over, kneeling and manual dexterity to apply the stair protectors and tape. There are limited directions and there is a learning curve to the installation process. I tried a variety of techniques, ie. tape on product first, top first, bottom first and became more proficient but never found an easy rhythm to the task. In my opinion, this job will be much easier for some rather difficult for others. I installed twenty four covers in approximately two and one half hours and that included the removal of the original rosin paper and relocation of some of the same on landings. The PRODUCT: is far superior to the red rosin paper on the stairs. Positive characteristics include: solid construction, safety warnings, non slip surface on the inside and outside of the product, easy fit, simple to trim. The Green tape is also far superior to the blue painters tape as it: tears easily to size, folds into 90 degree seams easily, adheres well but is forgiving when another try at location is necessary. The accompanying photo shows the first steps that I covered and my final product got better from there on. Overall, some may find this product pricey but in my opinion the safety provided for the workers and stairs greatly outweighs the price. I expect the Stair Armor to protect our staircase but understand that the product is not indestructible.

voices.snippet: Time will tell on quality. Instructions were pretty clear but my main disappointment was the gauge of metal for the brackets. They seem undersized and when install was complete it feels like there is some flex. Not quite a solid feel as all others I've purchased previously. For the price I had to give them a try. voices.title: Great upgrade for the truck!
voices.snippet: Nice looking and easy install with single 13mm socket for all bolts. Install time took just over 1 hour from opening the box to cleanup. Very simple bolt up for the 2026 Ram Big Horn - the running boards have some adjustability in where on the truck they can mount to the brackets. I opted for 4.25” from the integrated front “mud flap” (from end of the flap to the front of the board). That general spot allowed enough stepping area while matching similar setups in other cars. My family ranges from 5’ to 6’ and needed a little help getting in and out - these boards provide a good step into the truck. I had an older Ram and the boards were too high, so you’d have to duck to get in or bang your head; these running boards are a much more appropriate height. Great value for the money.

voices.title: These will fit your 2019 Ram 1500 Classic Crew Cab.
voices.snippet: Bought these for a 2019 Ram Classic. They fit well with no adjustments. Installation took between 2 and 3 hours. I was short a bolt and some washers, but they are hardware store items. You will also need some butyl tape to reseal the rocker panel holes. The truck has threaded holes for the front bracket and they have a some rust so I could not securely attach the front bracket with the bolts provided. I will need to cut some new threads some day. You should check your threads with an M8 bolt before buying. I bought these to make getting in and out of the truck easier. They cut down my ground clearance by a few inches.
